question: What is the title and ordinal of this instruction in the Kāmaratna?
premises: The verse names the work Kāmaratna.
It marks the section as second.
inference: This verse identifies the second instruction, on ākarṣaṇa, in the Kāmaratna.
plain_english: Thus ends the second instruction, named ākarṣaṇa, composed by Nityanātha in the Kāmaratna.
